text: Call `doc.GenManTree(cmd, header, dir)`. It generates a man page for the command and every descendant by delegating to `GenManTreeFromOpts` with the supplied header and directory and `"-"` as the command separator (`doc/man_docs.go:33-45`). For customization, `GenManTreeOptions` exposes `Header`, `Path`, and `CommandSeparator` (`doc/man_docs.go:82-88`).
